# Replay packages (draft)

Four of the synthetic example packages of
[`dekrops/verified-cli`](https://github.com/dekrops/verified-cli/tree/main/examples/derivation-replay)
and their trust registry, copied byte for byte. They are not the protocol's
conformance corpus: a recomputed authorization is proposed in RFC 0005 and
specified nowhere yet. The keys are test keys derived from fixed seeds.
